slot_scores.name: single_vehicle_per_customer
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are all 20 customers required to be served (i.e., every customer must be assigned to exactly one truck's route), or is it acceptable to leave some customers unserved?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each customer must be assigned to exactly one truck's route, covering the single-vehicle-per-customer requirement.

slot_scores.name: depot_return_requirement
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do all trucks start at the depot at time 0 and must they return to the depot after completing their route, or is returning to the depot optional?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether trucks must return to the depot or if return is optional, directly covering the depot return requirement.
